The marker profile_update_done is a typed value from the supervisor, so the flow branches on it before the model reads anything: a profile change (E11) has just been dealt with by the identity agent, which says no closing line of its own. nodes.detail: You are the front desk of the Toyota phone line. In this step you never speak to the caller: you read the caller's latest message, decide what it is and record it. The next step d…
nodes.comment: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Reading the caller. The only step that works out what a new message is. It never speaks and has no tools: it records desk_topic, or hands a specialist's request back. Three turns in a row with neither outcome go to a person (a backstop, not a use-case count). nodes.title: Safety question asked ≠ true?
nodes.comment: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Safety. Roadside, an accident, an injury or a locked-in child or pet escapes at once, and so does a caller who already says the car is not safe or that they are afraid to drive it: the one question would only ask what they have just said. A warning light, leak, smoke, noise or a brake or steering problem gets exactly one question. Safe to drive and they only want it looked at: a service visit is offered and the request goes back for booking with the concern as a note (E69). Anything else, or no clear answer: escape. A further concern on the same activation escapes without a second question. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cases.when: Adds a concern, like a brake noise, and the car is safe to drive
cases.agent_does: Sends it in the booking notes for the centre.

nodes.title: Safety second concern
nodes.comment: A further concern after the one question was answered with "safe": no second question. The note says what was asked and answered, so the safety agent starts from there.

nodes.title: Ask safe to drive
nodes.detail: Is the car safe to drive right now?
nodes.say: Is the car safe to drive right now?

nodes.title: Safety answer
nodes.detail: In this step you never speak to the caller. The caller reported this about their car: {{safety_note}}. You have just asked whether the car is safe to drive right now, and the call…
nodes.comment: Reads the answer to the one question. Silent, no tools. No answer recorded: treated as unsafe.

nodes.title: Safe offer
nodes.detail: We can book a service visit so the centre can check it. Would you like that?
nodes.say: We can book a service visit so the centre can check it. Would you like that?
nodes.comment: Safe to drive: carry on. A service visit is offered; listen reads the answer and hands a yes back as a booking request together with the concern, so the centre gets the note. Only the caller says that the car is safe to drive; the line never says so itself.

nodes.title: Safety not safe
nodes.comment: The one question was asked and the caller did not say that the car is safe to drive (not safe, unsure, afraid, or no clear answer). The note says so in plain words, so the safety agent does not ask the same question again.

nodes.title: Safety prepare
nodes.comment: The note is set before the flag, so the safety agent never starts without it. When the concern was not written down, the caller's last words stand in for it.

nodes.title: Safety question outcome known?
nodes.comment: When the one question was asked, what it established is added to the note. The note is the field the safety agent reads as "reported earlier, do not ask again", so this is what keeps it from asking the same question a second time.

nodes.title: Raise safety
nodes.comment: The escape itself. The flag is set and the hand-off is made in this one step: the flow never completes with the flag raised, because completing would only return to the supervisor.

nodes.title: Product forklift
nodes.comment: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- N20 Toyota forklift or Hino truck: not serviced at Toyota centres; give the Toyota Material Handling or Hino number from the contact directory (get_contact_number). OPEN N20 (contact centre): How often does the contact centre get this call? The answer decides whether the AI agent takes this call at all, so it is a switch: TOYOTA_FRONTDESK_TMH_HINO_REDIRECT, default "true". Unset or any value other than "false" is the interim behaviour of the use-case document (the number is given). Only the value "false" switches it off: the caller then goes to a person. The model is not in the path of the number: listen only records which product it is, the directory returns the number, and a fixed line says it. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- N20: a forklift or other material handling equipment. The key is the directory's; the team name is the one in the use case and is only used if the directory returns no name.

nodes.title: Reply greeting
nodes.detail: The caller greeted you, or said yes or okay without saying what they need. Write desk_reply: one short, warm sentence that returns the greeting or acknowledges them, in the langua…
nodes.comment: A greeting, or a yes with no request: one short reply worded by the model (so that a greeting is returned the way it was given), then the fixed question. Neither is a failure to understand, so the count of E20 is not touched. Order of speech: the model does not say the reply. It writes it to desk_reply and a fixed step says it, because a reasoning step that speaks and then goes on to a fixed line in the same turn is heard after that line: the question would come before the greeting. The step always ends after one pass; when nothing was written the fixed question is said alone.
